req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-002 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is missing from POST /tasks/. The schema enforces title as required (min_length=1). Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid payload returns 201; (2) negative EP — missing title returns 422; (3) BVA boundary — empty string title (length=0, below min_length=1) returns 422; (4) NEG — null title returns 422; (5) DT — title present but only whitespace is a decision-table edge. Each test asserts exact status codes and key response fields to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with a valid JSON body containing title='Valid Task'
expected: Response JSON contains id (integer), title='Valid Task', completed=False
trace: R-TASK-002 — positive equivalence partition: well-formed request must succeed
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Valid Task"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Valid Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201()

expected: Response JSON contains 'detail' key with validation error information
trace: R-TASK-002 — primary error pathway: missing title must yield 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"description": "No title here", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    fields = [err["loc"] for err in body["detail"]]
    assert any("title" in loc for loc in fields)

test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422()
